data.description:
## Goal
Write tests/scripts/test-bypass-log-enforcement.sh before enforcement exists (RED). Tests cover log entry presence, hard error on missing log, artifact bundle inclusion.

## Test Cases
1. Gate override with bypass log entry (rationale + caller context fields) -> exits 0
2. Gate override with no bypass log entry -> exits 1 (hard error)
3. Gate override with bypass log but missing rationale field -> exits 1
4. Gate override with bypass log but missing caller_context field -> exits 1
5. Artifact bundle includes bypass log entries -> check passes -> exits 0
6. Artifact bundle with override but no bypass log -> exits 1

## Acceptance Criteria
- bash tests/scripts/test-bypass-log-enforcement.sh exits non-zero (RED)
- chmod +x tests/scripts/test-bypass-log-enforcement.sh

## Testing Mode
RED (depends S3 closure gate protocol for override intercept point)
data.title: T1: RED — Write test suite for bypass-log enforcement
